info.description: Enterprise-grade E2E Postman Suite for the IT DR Registry Service Domain (BIAN-aligned, ADR-001/005/013/019/030/031/032/033). Creates a recovery plan (a strategy, a recovery time and a recovery point objective, how often to prove it, a runbook reference), reads and lists it, reports a passed walk through the runbook (which counts as a pass but measures nothing), a passed failover and a later passed full recovery (which measure the objectives), the same exercise again (200, the stored one), a partial exercise with a reason from the fixed list and an old failure reported late, and shows how the plan judges itself when read: NEVER_TESTED, READY, LAST_EXERCISE_FAILED until a later pass clears it, OBJECTIVE_MISSED when the last measured pass was slower than the recovery time (and READY again when the objective is loosened), a paused plan not judged, and a report that arrives late moving nothing forward. It updates the definition, pauses and resumes the plan, lists exercises newest first with filters and a limit, and reads the audit ledger in order. A second folder proves the registry is staff only (a REQUESTER gets 403 ERR-DRR-00403 on every route). A third covers the negative guarantees: validation (blank or long name, missing asset or strategy, objectives and intervals out of range, a backup-restore plan promising to lose nothing, a runbook reference that is a sentence, malformed identifiers, missing tenant or executor), duplicate names (409) on create and on rename, illegal transitions, updating a paused plan, exercises that are inconsistent (a failed or partial one without a reason, a passed one with a reason, a reason that is free text, finishing before the start or in the future, a negative or huge data loss), an exercise for a plan that is not the tenant's, tenant isolation, limits of the exercise list, and the absence of DELETE and of any edit of an exercise, with RFC 7807 error_code assertions. It files everything under its own generated tenant id (drOrganisationId). A plan becoming overdue as time passes is proved by the unit tests of the domain (a plan cannot be backdated); the race of simultaneous reports of one exercise, two people pausing at once and the ledger are proved by the platform smoke (dr-smoke).
